sources.snippet: What is Qwen3-Coder-Next? Qwen3-Coder-Next is the latest open-weight language model from the Qwen Team, built specifically for coding agents and local development. Unlike traditional dense models, it utilizes a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. While it boasts a massive 80B total parameter count, it only activates 3B parameters per token.
